purpose: Choose one passenger-model setting using the 19 daytime development commands, before opening the separate night bank or scoring the new public cases.
geometry_selection: Training-only four-fold source-group exploration favored the mode of retrieved offsets. The daytime development replay improved approximate location and recovered a clarification follow-up. Retain the linear head as the comparison because it hit more of the 125 public masks under oracle landmarks.
conditions: model-selected landmark with learned retrieved geometry
same plus a second visual check of selected landmarks and alternative crops
choice: Select visual checking for the normal application if fewer than 3 of the 8 unresolved requests get a proposal, at least 8 of 11 clear requests get a proposal, and at least 7 of 11 are within 5% of image diagonal. Otherwise retain single-pass as the reference. Validate the selected condition on new groups and report all misses. These are internal development selection rules.
counts: Keep every request, including malformed output, timeout and resource failure. A scripted confirmation, a passenger-drawn box and a direct model proposal are separate measurements.
